arrive.text: Be still. Let your shoulders drop and take a slow breath. God is here with you right now, and He is not in a hurry.

v.t: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”

arrive.text: Before you say anything, simply rest. The Lord has promised that His presence will go with you. Breathe in, breathe out, and let your heart settle.

v.t: And the LORD answered, “My Presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”

arrive.text: Find a quiet place and let the noise fade. Your soul can rest in God alone. He has been waiting to meet with you.

v.t: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.

arrive.text: Come as you are, tired or full of questions. Jesus invites you to come to Him and rest. Take a deep breath and let Him hold the weight for a moment.

v.t: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

arrive.text: In quietness and trust you will find strength. Slow down. You do not have to earn this time; just be here with Him.

v.t: For the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, has said: “By repentance and rest you would be saved; your strength would lie in quiet confidence— but you were not willing.”

arrive.text: There is nowhere you can go where God is not already there. Breathe slowly. He is closer than your next breath.

v.t: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?

arrive.text: The Lord your God is with you, and He delights in you. Let that settle over you as you breathe deeply. You are welcome here.

v.t: The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

arrive.text: Pause and notice the quiet around you. In God’s presence there is fullness of joy. Let the rush of the day wait outside for a while.

v.t: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.

arrive.text: Take a breath and remember that the Lord goes before you and will never leave you. Quiet your thoughts. He is already here.

v.t: The LORD Himself goes before you; He will be with you. He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid or discouraged.”

arrive.text: It is good to wait quietly for the Lord. Close your eyes if you like and breathe slowly. Let your heart turn toward Him.

v.t: The LORD is good to those who wait for Him, to the soul who seeks Him. It is good to wait quietly for the salvation of the LORD.

arrive.text: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Set down your phone and your to-do list. Breathe, and know that He is listening.

v.t: Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

arrive.text: Picture green pastures and still waters. Your Shepherd leads you there to restore your soul. Take a slow breath and rest in His care.

v.t: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters. He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

arrive.text: Jesus promised to be with you always. Let that promise slow you down. Breathe in His peace and breathe out your hurry.

v.t: …and teaching them to obey all that I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”

honor.prayer: Holy, holy, holy are You, Lord God Almighty. There is no one like You. You are pure and perfect, without any darkness at all. The angels cover their faces before You, and yet You invite me to come close. I bow my heart before You today. Thank You that through Jesus I can stand in Your holy presence, washed clean and welcomed. Let my life reflect Your holiness. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Faithful God, You have never once broken a promise. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies, and Your mercies are new every morning. When I am unsteady, You stay the same. When I forget You, You do not forget me. I look back over my life and see Your hand in every season. I praise You for keeping Your word to me, to my family, and to every generation. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Creator of heaven and earth, I praise You. You spoke, and light appeared. You set the stars in place and know each one by name. You shaped the mountains, filled the oceans, and painted every sunrise. You also made me, knit together with care and purpose. Open my eyes today to see Your fingerprints all around me. All creation sings Your praise, and I gladly join the song. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are my Shepherd, and I have everything I need. You lead me beside quiet waters and restore my soul. When I wander, You come looking for me. When I walk through dark valleys, You are right beside me. Jesus, You are the Good Shepherd who laid down Your life for Your sheep. I praise You for Your tender, faithful care, today and every day. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, You are the Light of the world. In You there is no darkness at all. Your light shines into every hidden corner and drives away fear. When I cannot see the path ahead, Your word is a lamp to my feet. I praise You for calling me out of darkness into Your wonderful light. Shine through me today so others can see Your goodness. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are my Rock. Everything else shifts and changes, but You stand firm. When storms come and the ground feels like sand, I can build my life on You. You are my fortress and my safe place. No one can move You, and nothing can shake Your promises. I praise You for being solid, steady, and strong. I put my full weight on You today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Merciful Father, I praise You for Your great compassion. You do not treat me as my sins deserve. You are slow to anger and rich in love. As far as the east is from the west, You have removed my wrongs from me. Your mercy found me when I was lost, and it still holds me today. Thank You that Your kindness never runs dry. I worship You, God of mercy. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are King of kings and Lord of lords. Your throne lasts forever, and Your kingdom will never end. Rulers rise and fall, but You reign over all. You are worthy of all honor, glory, and power. And yet, my King, You came as a servant and wore a crown of thorns for me. I gladly bow before You and give You my loyalty and my love today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Father, what a gift it is to call You by that name. You have adopted me as Your child and made me part of Your family. You know what I need before I ask. You correct me with love and never stop caring for me. Your arms are always open, like the father who ran to welcome his son home. I praise You for Your perfect, patient love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are my Provider. You fed Your people with manna in the desert and gave them water from a rock. You clothe the lilies and feed the birds of the air. Every good thing I have comes from Your hand. My food, my home, my breath, and my friends are all gifts from You. I praise You for meeting every need from Your riches in Christ Jesus. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are the God who heals. Jesus, You touched the sick, opened blind eyes, and made broken bodies whole. You heal broken hearts and bind up their wounds. Nothing is too hard for You. I praise You for the healing You have already done in my life, in body and in soul. I trust You with every hurt that remains. You are the Great Physician, and I worship You. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are the same yesterday, today, and forever. The world around me changes every day. People change, plans change, and my feelings change. But You do not. Your love is constant, Your word stands firm, and Your character is always good. I praise You for being the One I can count on in every season. My hope is secure because You never change. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, I praise You for being near. You are not a distant God watching from far away. You are close to the brokenhearted and near to all who call on You. Jesus, You came and lived among us as Immanuel, God with us. Your Spirit lives in me now. Thank You that I never pray into empty air. You are here, and You are listening to me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Mighty God, I praise Your power. You parted the Red Sea, brought down the walls of Jericho, and raised Jesus from the dead. Nothing is impossible for You. The same power that conquered the grave is at work in those who believe. I lift up Your strength today, because my own strength is small. Be mighty in my weakness, and let the world see what You can do. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, Your wisdom is deeper than the ocean. You know the end from the beginning, and Your ways are higher than my ways. You never make a mistake. When I do not understand, I can trust that You see what I cannot. I praise You for the wisdom of the cross, which looks foolish to the world but saves all who believe. Teach me to walk in Your wisdom today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Patient Father, I praise You for Your long-suffering love. You waited for me when I was running my own way. You do not give up on me when I stumble again and again. You are patient with this world, not wanting anyone to perish but all to come to repentance. Thank You for every second chance and every new morning. Help me show others the same patience You show me. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Righteous Judge, I praise You because You are always just. You see every wrong done on earth, and nothing escapes Your notice. You defend the weak, the poor, and the forgotten. One day You will set everything right. And at the cross, Your justice and mercy met together, as Jesus took the penalty I deserved. I worship You, the God who is perfectly fair and perfectly kind. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, my Redeemer, I praise You. You bought me back at the highest price, not with silver or gold, but with Your own precious blood. You took what was broken and lost and made it Yours. Nothing in my story is beyond Your power to redeem. I am no longer a slave to sin. I am free. Thank You for paying it all. My life belongs to You. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, You are the Prince of Peace. You calmed the wind and the waves with a word. You made peace between me and God through Your cross. You give a peace the world cannot give and cannot take away. When my heart is troubled, You speak calm into the storm. I praise You for being my peace today. Let Your peace rule in my heart and guard my mind. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are good, and Your love endures forever. Everything You do flows from Your goodness. Even when life is hard, You are working all things together for good for those who love You. Your goodness and mercy follow me all the days of my life. I have tasted and seen that You are good. I praise You simply for who You are, a good God, always and forever. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

God, You are love. Before I ever loved You, You loved me. You loved the world so much that You gave Your only Son. Nothing can separate me from Your love, not death or life, not height or depth, not anything in all creation. Your love is wide and long and high and deep, more than I can measure. I praise You, and I rest in Your love today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are my refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. When fear comes, I can run to You and be safe. You cover me the way a bird shelters her young under her wings. You are my hiding place. I praise You for being a shelter that never fails, a strong tower where I am protected. Today I choose to take refuge in You and nowhere else. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Everlasting God, You have no beginning and no end. Before the mountains were born, from forever to forever, You are God. A thousand years are like a single day to You. My life is short, but You hold it in Your eternal hands. I praise You that through Jesus You have given me eternal life. One day I will worship You face to face forever. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You know everything. You know when I sit down and when I rise. You know my thoughts before I think them and my words before I speak them. You count the hairs on my head. Nothing is hidden from You, and still You love me completely. I praise You that I never have to explain myself to You. You understand me fully and care for me perfectly. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, You are the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world. You were led like a lamb to the slaughter, and You did not open Your mouth. You gave Yourself willingly for me. Now all heaven sings that You are worthy, because by Your blood You ransomed people for God. I join that song today with all my heart. Worthy is the Lamb. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Holy Spirit, I praise You as my Comforter and Helper. Jesus promised that You would come, and You have. You live in me, guide me into truth, and remind me of His words. When I do not know how to pray, You pray for me with groans too deep for words. Thank You for Your gentle presence and Your quiet strength. I welcome You to fill me today. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, You are the resurrection and the life. You stood at the tomb of Lazarus and called him out. Then You walked out of Your own grave, alive forever. Death has lost its sting because of You. I praise You for the living hope You give me. Whatever feels dead in my life, You can bring back to life. I worship You today, my risen and reigning Lord. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, I praise You for calling me Your friend. You are a friend who sticks closer than a brother. You laid down Your life for Your friends, and there is no greater love than that. You welcome my honest words and know my heart. You never grow tired of me. Thank You for walking with me through every ordinary day. I am so grateful to be Your friend. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Jesus, You are the Bread of Life. Whoever comes to You will never go hungry. The world offers so many things that leave me empty, but You satisfy my soul. You fed the crowds with a few loaves and fish, and You feed me still. I praise You for being everything I truly need. Fill me again today, and let me share You with someone else. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Lord, You are the God who sees me. When Hagar was alone in the desert, You found her and spoke to her. You see me too. You see the tears no one else notices and the quiet faithfulness no one applauds. I am never invisible to You. I praise You for Your watchful, loving eyes. Thank You for seeing me fully and loving me anyway. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

Sovereign Lord, You rule over all things. Nothing happens outside Your knowledge or beyond Your reach. You hold the nations in Your hand, and You hold the details of my day too. Your plans cannot be stopped. When the world feels out of control, I remember that You are still on the throne. I praise You for Your perfect authority, and I gladly trust my life to You. In Jesus’ name, Amen.

thanks.prompt: Name one way God has been good to you this past week. Say it out loud and thank Him for it.

v.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

thanks.prompt: Think of something hard you are facing right now. Thank God for one thing He is teaching you or giving you in the middle of it.

v.t: Give thanks in every circumstance, for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

thanks.prompt: Bring to mind one person who has been a gift to you. Thank God for them by name, and for one specific thing you love about them.

v.t: I thank my God every time I remember you.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for the gift of Jesus. Tell Him what it means to you today that your sins are forgiven.

v.t: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift!

thanks.prompt: Notice one small joy from today or yesterday, like a good cup of coffee, a kind word, or a moment of laughter. Thank God for it, because every good gift comes from Him.

v.t: Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.

thanks.prompt: Think of something beautiful in creation you have seen recently, a sky, a tree, a quiet morning. Thank God for His artistry in it.

v.t: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.

thanks.prompt: Remember a prayer God has answered, recently or long ago. Thank Him for hearing you and for bending down to listen.

v.t: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy. Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.

thanks.prompt: Name one way God has provided for you this week: food on the table, a paycheck, a ride, a shared meal. Thank Him for His daily care.

v.t: Look at the birds of the air: They do not sow or reap or gather into barns—and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not much more valuable than they?

thanks.prompt: You woke up this morning to new mercies. Thank God for one fresh start He has given you today.

v.t: Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!

thanks.prompt: Think of a difficult season in your past that made you stronger or brought you closer to God. Thank Him for how He used it.

v.t: Not only that, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for one way He made you: a skill, a trait, or the way your heart cares for others. You are wonderfully made.

v.t: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.

thanks.prompt: Do not forget the good things God has done. Name three blessings in your life right now, one at a time, and thank Him for each.

v.t: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—

thanks.prompt: This is a day the Lord has made. Thank Him for one thing you are looking forward to today, even something small.

v.t: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

thanks.prompt: Remember a time God gave you strength when you felt weak. Thank Him for carrying you through.

v.t: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for the victory you have in Jesus over sin and death. Name one area where you have seen Him give you freedom.

v.t: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!

thanks.prompt: Recall one of the wonderful things God has done in your life. Tell Him the story again with a thankful heart.

v.t: I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for your church family and the believers who have encouraged your faith. Name one of them before Him now.

v.t: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints, I have not stopped giving thanks for you, remembering you in my prayers,

thanks.prompt: Thank the Father for bringing you into His kingdom and making you His child. Tell Him what it means to you to belong to Him.

v.t: …giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light. He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

thanks.prompt: Thank God for rest, for a place to sleep, and for keeping you through the night. He sustained you, and here you are.

v.t: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.

thanks.prompt: Think of an unexpected kindness someone showed you recently. Thank God, who often shows His goodness through people.

v.t: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for His Word. Name one verse or truth from the Bible that has helped you lately.

v.t: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!

thanks.prompt: Remember a time God turned your sorrow into joy. Thank Him for His comfort and for the hope He gave you.

v.t: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy, that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.

thanks.prompt: Think about the gift of your life today: breath in your lungs, eyes to read, hands to work. Thank God for each one.

v.t: Nor is He served by human hands, as if He needed anything, because He Himself gives everyone life and breath and everything else.

thanks.prompt: Think of something good God has done in your family, your home, or among your friends. Thank Him for it with joy.

v.t: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.

thanks.prompt: Look at the ordinary tasks ahead of you today. Thank God for the work He has given you and the ability to do it.

v.t: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for His love itself, not only for what He gives. Tell Him one reason His love is better than life to you.

v.t: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for someone who first told you about Jesus or helped you grow in faith. Name them and thank God for their faithfulness.

v.t: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as did my forefathers, as I constantly remember you night and day in my prayers.

thanks.prompt: Think of a worry from the past that God carried you through. Thank Him that His love endures forever and that He came through for you.

v.t: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.

thanks.prompt: Thank God for this time with Him right now. Tell Him you are glad you can come to Him anytime, anywhere.

v.t: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,

concerns.guide: God invites you to bring Him everything, not just the big things. Picture yourself opening your hands and placing each worry in His. His peace will guard your heart as you let go.
concerns.ask: What is weighing on you today?

v.t: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

concerns.guide: Imagine picking up each worry like a stone and placing it on Jesus’ strong shoulders. He is not bothered by your cares; He cares for you. Let each one go as you name it.
concerns.ask: Which worries can you cast on Him right now?

v.t: Cast all your anxiety on Him, because He cares for you.

concerns.guide: Picture a heavy backpack you have been carrying for days. Jesus kneels beside you, unbuckles the straps, and lifts it off your shoulders. His yoke is easy and His burden is light.
concerns.ask: What is in your backpack today?

v.t: Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me; for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls. For My yoke is easy and My burden is light.”

concerns.guide: Think of the disciples in the boat as the waves crashed in. Jesus stood up, spoke to the wind, and the sea grew calm. He is in your boat too.
concerns.ask: What storm do you need Him to calm today?

v.t: Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.

concerns.guide: Picture a shepherd gathering a tired lamb into his arms and holding it close to his heart. That is how Jesus carries you. You do not have to walk this road alone.
concerns.ask: Where do you need to be carried today?

v.t: He tends His flock like a shepherd; He gathers the lambs in His arms and carries them close to His heart. He gently leads the nursing ewes.

concerns.guide: Imagine setting your burden down at the Lord’s feet, the way you set down heavy bags at the door. He promises to sustain you. He will not let you fall.
concerns.ask: What burden can you set down now?

v.t: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.

concerns.guide: Jesus tells you not to let your heart be troubled. Picture Him sitting across from you, looking at you with kindness, ready to hear it all. Tell Him what troubles you as you would tell a trusted friend.
concerns.ask: What is troubling your heart?

v.t: Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled; do not be afraid.

concerns.guide: Many of our worries live in tomorrow. Picture placing each tomorrow worry in a box and handing it to the One who is already there. Today, you only need grace for today.
concerns.ask: What worries about tomorrow can you give Him?

v.t: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself. Today has enough trouble of its own.

concerns.guide: Fear is real, but you do not have to face it alone. Imagine a child reaching for a parent’s hand in the dark. Reach for God’s hand now; He is already holding yours.
concerns.ask: What are you afraid of right now?

v.t: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.

concerns.guide: God says you do not need to fear, because He is with you. Picture His hand holding you up, steady and strong, like a firm grip on an icy path. He will strengthen you and help you.
concerns.ask: Where do you need His strength today?

v.t: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.

concerns.guide: Picture pouring water from a full pitcher until it is empty. God invites you to pour out your heart to Him like that, holding nothing back. He is a safe place for every word.
concerns.ask: What do you need to pour out to Him?

v.t: Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah

concerns.guide: Not one sparrow is forgotten by God, and you are worth far more than many sparrows. Picture Him knowing even the number of hairs on your head. He knows every detail of what concerns you.
concerns.ask: What details do you need to trust Him with?

v.t: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God. And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.

concerns.guide: Lift your eyes from your problems to the Lord who made heaven and earth. Your help does not come from your own strength. Picture Him watching over you, never sleeping, never distracted.
concerns.ask: Where do you need help today?

v.t: I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come? My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.

concerns.guide: Picture yourself at a crossroads, unsure which way to go. Instead of leaning on your own understanding, you lean on Jesus, and He points the way. He will make your path straight.
concerns.ask: What decision are you unsure about?

v.t: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make your paths straight.

concerns.guide: When you pass through deep waters, God has promised to be with you. Picture Him walking beside you through the river, holding you so the current cannot sweep you away. You will not be overwhelmed.
concerns.ask: What deep waters are you walking through?

v.t: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.

concerns.guide: You do not have to be strong enough. Picture handing Jesus your empty hands and your tired heart, and watch Him fill them with His grace. His power shows up best in your weakness.
concerns.ask: Where do you feel weak today?

v.t: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.

concerns.guide: If your heart is hurting, the Lord draws near, not away. Imagine Jesus sitting with you in your sorrow, quiet and close. You can bring Him your tears.
concerns.ask: What is breaking your heart right now?

v.t: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.

concerns.guide: Picture a tangle of threads in your hands. Now picture God taking them and weaving them into something good, one strand at a time. He is working in all things for those who love Him.
concerns.ask: What tangled situation can you place in His hands?

v.t: And we know that God works all things together for the good of those who love Him, who are called according to His purpose.

concerns.guide: The Lord will fight for you; you only need to be still. Picture Israel standing at the Red Sea with nowhere to run, and God opening a way through. Let Him go before you into this battle.
concerns.ask: What battle do you need Him to fight for you?

v.t: The LORD will fight for you; you need only to be still.”

concerns.guide: Picture stepping out of a cold rain into a warm shelter. That is what it is like to rest in the shadow of the Almighty. Bring your worries in from the storm and let Him cover you.
concerns.ask: What do you need shelter from today?

v.t: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”

concerns.guide: Peter began to sink when he looked at the wind and the waves. Jesus reached out His hand at once and caught him. Look away from the waves and back to Jesus now.
concerns.ask: What waves are pulling your eyes away from Him?

v.t: But when he saw the strength of the wind, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!” Immediately Jesus reached out His hand and took hold of Peter. “You of little faith,” He said, “why did you doubt?”

concerns.guide: Imagine writing your plans and worries on a page and placing it in God’s hands for safekeeping. Commit your way to the Lord and trust in Him. He will act on your behalf.
concerns.ask: What plans do you need to commit to Him?

v.t: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.

concerns.guide: God holds your future, and His plans for you are good. Picture Him holding a map of your whole life, with every turn already known. You can trust Him with the road ahead.
concerns.ask: What about the future is worrying you?

v.t: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the LORD, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, to give you a future and a hope.

concerns.guide: Jesus never promised a life without trouble, but He did promise that He has overcome the world. Picture setting your trouble down beside His empty tomb. Nothing you face is bigger than His victory.
concerns.ask: What trouble are you facing today?

v.t: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!”

concerns.guide: Picture walking up to a throne, not shaking in fear but welcomed in. Jesus understands your weakness, and His throne is a throne of grace. Come with confidence and tell Him what you need.
concerns.ask: What do you need help with today?

v.t: For we do not have a high priest who is unable to sympathize with our weaknesses, but we have one who was tempted in every way that we are, yet was without sin. Let us then approach the throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

concerns.guide: Picture a ship tossed by the wind but held fast by an anchor deep below the waves. Your hope in Jesus is that anchor for your soul. Let Him hold you steady while the waters move.
concerns.ask: What is tossing you around right now?

v.t: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure. It enters the inner sanctuary behind the curtain,

concerns.guide: God keeps in perfect peace the mind that stays fixed on Him. Picture turning your face away from the noise and toward Him, like turning toward the warmth of the sun. As you name each worry, keep your eyes on Him.
concerns.ask: What thoughts keep stealing your peace?

v.t: You will keep in perfect peace the steadfast of mind, because he trusts in You.

concerns.guide: Picture a child bringing a need to a loving parent, sure they will be heard. Your Father in heaven loves you even more and knows how to give good gifts. Bring your needs to Him with that same confidence.
concerns.ask: What do you need from your Father today?

v.t: Which of you, if his son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, will give him a snake? So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!

concerns.guide: Underneath you are the everlasting arms. Picture leaning back and being caught by strong, gentle arms that will never let you drop. You can rest your whole weight on Him.
concerns.ask: What are you trying to hold up by yourself?

v.t: The eternal God is your dwelling place, and underneath are the everlasting arms. He drives out the enemy before you, giving the command, ‘Destroy him!’

concerns.guide: When anxious thoughts pile up, God’s comfort can bring joy to your soul. Picture each racing thought slowing down as you hand it to Him, one at a time. He has room for every one of them.
concerns.ask: What anxious thoughts can you hand Him now?

v.t: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.

concerns.guide: Even in the darkest valley, you do not have to fear, because your Shepherd is with you. Picture His staff guiding your steps and His presence lighting the way. You are not walking through this alone.
concerns.ask: What valley are you walking through?

v.t: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.

others.guide: Ask God to bring one person to mind who needs prayer today. When a name comes, pray for them simply and specifically. Ask God to bless them, protect them, and draw them close to Himself.

v.t: Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition. To this end, stay alert with all perseverance in your prayers for all the saints.

others.guide: Ask the Lord to show you someone who is carrying a heavy load right now. Pray for them by name and ask God to lift their burden. Is there a small way you could help carry it today?

v.t: Carry one another’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

others.guide: Think of someone who is hard to love, perhaps someone who has hurt you. Pray for them by name and ask God to bless them. Praying for them is one way God softens your heart too.

v.t: But I tell you, love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,

others.guide: Ask God to bring to mind someone who does not yet know Jesus. Pray that their heart would open to Him and that they would see His love. Ask God for a chance to share today’s word with them.

v.t: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is for their salvation.

others.guide: Think of a neighbor, someone who lives or works near you. Pray for them by name and ask God what they need. Ask Him to show you one way to love them this week.

v.t: He answered, “‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’”

others.guide: Bring a family member before God. Pray that they would know His will, grow in wisdom, and feel His love today. Name them and lift their needs to the Father.

v.t: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

others.guide: MannaFish is about two fish: one for you and one to give away. Ask God who should receive your second fish today. Pray for that person by name, then send them today’s word.

v.t: “Come, follow Me,” Jesus said, “and I will make you fishers of men.”

others.guide: Pray for someone in leadership: a pastor, a boss, a teacher, or a government leader. Ask God to give them wisdom, humility, and courage. Pray for them by name.

v.t: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgiving be offered for everyone— for kings and all those in authority—so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity.

others.guide: Ask God to bring to mind someone who is grieving or lonely. Pray that the God of all comfort would hold them close today. Consider sending them a short message to let them know you prayed.

v.t: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our troubles, so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.

others.guide: A boy once gave Jesus five loaves and two fish, and Jesus fed thousands. Ask God who could be fed by what He gave you today. Pray for that person, then pass along today’s word as your small offering.

v.t: “Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”

others.guide: Think of a close friend. Pray that their love would keep growing and that they would know what is best. Thank God for them and ask Him to bless their day.

v.t: And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight, so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,

others.guide: Ask God to bring to mind someone who is sick or in pain. Pray for their healing, for wise doctors, and for peace while they wait. Name them before the Lord in faith.

v.t: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord. And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up. If he has sinned, he will be forgiven.

others.guide: Pray for someone serving God far from home, like a missionary or ministry worker. Ask God to strengthen them, provide for them, and bear fruit through their work. If you know one by name, lift them up now.

v.t: Then He said to His disciples, “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.”

others.guide: Bring a child or young person before God, maybe your own or one you know. Pray that they would know Jesus early and walk with Him all their life. Ask God to protect them today.

v.t: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

others.guide: Think of a coworker or classmate. Ask God to open the eyes of their heart to see the hope He offers. Pray for them by name, and look for a chance to show them kindness today.

v.t: I ask that the eyes of your heart may be enlightened, so that you may know the hope of His calling, the riches of His glorious inheritance in the saints,

others.guide: Think of someone who once walked with God but has drifted away. Jesus leaves the ninety-nine to find the one. Pray by name that He would gently bring them home.

v.t: “What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?

others.guide: Ask God to show you someone who is celebrating or someone who is weeping. Pray for them by name, sharing in their joy or their sorrow. Let them know you are thinking of them.

v.t: Rejoice with those who rejoice; weep with those who weep.

others.guide: Four friends once carried a man to Jesus because he could not get there on his own. Who do you need to carry to Jesus in prayer today? Name them and lay them at His feet.

v.t: Then a paralytic was brought to Him, carried by four men. Since they were unable to get to Jesus through the crowd, they uncovered the roof above Him, made an opening, and lowered the paralytic on his mat. When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”

others.guide: Pray for believers around the world who suffer for their faith. Ask God to give them courage, protect them, and supply what they need. If a name or a country comes to mind, pray for it specifically.

v.t: Remember those in prison as if you were bound with them, and those who are mistreated as if you were suffering with them.

others.guide: Ask God to bring to mind someone who might be curious about your faith. Pray for an open door to share the hope you have. Consider sharing today’s word with them, gently and with kindness.

v.t: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you. But respond with gentleness and respect,

others.guide: Pray for someone who is often overlooked: a widow, a single parent, someone in prison, or someone without a home. Ask God to defend them and to show you how you can help.

v.t: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor. Defend the fatherless and plead the case of the widow.”

others.guide: Think of someone who has helped your faith grow. Thank God for them, and pray for whatever they are facing right now. Send them a note today to let them know you prayed.

v.t: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers

others.guide: Ask God to bring to mind someone you have been meaning to talk with about Jesus. Pray for them by name and ask for the right words at the right time. Share today’s word with them as your second fish.

v.t: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time. Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

response.guide: Ask the Holy Spirit to show you anything that stands between you and God. Confess it honestly, without excuses. Then receive His forgiveness; He is faithful to make you clean.

v.t: If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

response.guide: Ask God for a clean heart and a right spirit. Tell Him where you have fallen short since you last prayed. Let Him wash you and make you new.

v.t: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.

response.guide: Offer your whole self to God today: your body, your time, and your plans. Tell Him simply, Lord, I am Yours. Let this be your act of worship.

v.t: Therefore I urge you, brothers, on account of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as living sacrifices, holy and pleasing to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.

response.guide: Look at your plans for today and hand them to God one by one. Ask Him to guide each meeting, task, and conversation. Commit your work to Him and trust Him with the results.

v.t: Commit your works to the LORD and your plans will be achieved.

response.guide: Is there someone you need to forgive? Remember how much the Lord has forgiven you. Choose today to release them and let God handle the rest.

v.t: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

response.guide: Do not only hear God’s Word; do what it says. Ask Him for one clear step of obedience for today. Write it down, and then do it.

v.t: Be doers of the word, and not hearers only. Otherwise, you are deceiving yourselves.

response.guide: You cannot live this day well in your own strength. Ask the Holy Spirit to fill you and lead you. Choose to walk with Him moment by moment.

v.t: So I say, walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.

response.guide: Jesus prayed that the Father’s will would be done, not His own. Is there an area where you have been holding on to your own way? Tell God you are willing to follow His will there.

v.t: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”

response.guide: Invite God to search your heart and know your anxious thoughts. Ask Him to point out anything in you that grieves Him. Then ask Him to lead you in His everlasting way.

v.t: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns. See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.

response.guide: Is there a relationship that needs repair? Ask God for the humility to make the first move. Consider reaching out today to apologize or make peace.

v.t: So if you are offering your gift at the altar and there remember that your brother has something against you, leave your gift there before the altar. First go and be reconciled to your brother; then come and offer your gift.

response.guide: Ask God how you can do justice, love mercy, and walk humbly today. Choose one way to show kindness to someone. Walk humbly with your God in it.

v.t: He has shown you, O man, what is good. And what does the LORD require of you but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

response.guide: Ask God to show you any bitterness, anger, or harsh words you have been holding on to. Give them to Him, and ask Him to fill that space with kindness and compassion.

v.t: Get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, outcry and slander, along with every form of malice. Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.

response.guide: No matter what you have done, God invites you to come and be made clean. Bring Him your sins, even the ones that embarrass you. He will make them white as snow.

v.t: “Come now, let us reason together,” says the LORD. “Though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow; though they are as red as crimson, they will become like wool.

response.guide: Following Jesus means saying no to yourself and yes to Him. What is one thing you need to lay down today to follow Him more closely? Tell Him, and take up your cross.

v.t: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.

response.guide: Jesus said that those who love Him will keep His commands. Ask Him to show you one command you can obey today out of love. Let your obedience be a gift to Him.

v.t: If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.

response.guide: Do not hide your sin; bring it into the light. Tell God plainly what you have done. Feel the weight lift as He forgives your guilt.

v.t: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

response.guide: Give God your hands, your eyes, your words, and your thoughts for this day. Ask Him to use each one for what is right. You belong to Him now.

v.t: Do not present the parts of your body to sin as instruments of wickedness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and present the parts of your body to Him as instruments of righteousness.

response.guide: Ask God to help you take every thought captive today. When a worry, a lie, or a temptation comes, turn it over to Jesus. Choose to dwell on what is true.

v.t: We tear down arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God; and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

response.guide: Today you get to choose whom you will serve. Tell the Lord again that you choose Him. Ask Him to make your home and your heart places where He is honored.

v.t: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD, then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living. As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!”

response.guide: Ask the Holy Spirit to teach you and remind you of what Jesus said. Is there a word from Jesus you have been ignoring? Ask Him for help to live it out today.

v.t: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have told you.

response.guide: God cares more about your obedience than your good intentions. Is there something He has already asked you to do that you have put off? Decide today to say yes.

v.t: But Samuel declared: “Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices as much as in obedience to His voice? Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice, and attentiveness is better than the fat of rams.

response.guide: Picture setting aside anything that slows you down in your walk with God: a habit, a distraction, a sin that clings tightly. Name it and ask God to help you lay it down. Then fix your eyes on Jesus.

v.t: Therefore, since we are surrounded by such a great cloud of witnesses, let us throw off every encumbrance and the sin that so easily entangles, and let us run with endurance the race set out for us. Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy set before Him endured the cross, scorning its shame, and sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

response.guide: Ask God to put your priorities in order today. What would it look like to seek His kingdom first in your schedule and your choices? Give Him the first place.

v.t: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.

response.guide: Jesus said that when you stand praying, you should forgive anyone you hold something against. Bring that person to mind now. Release the debt, and ask God to heal what still hurts.

v.t: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.”

response.guide: Obedience is not something you do alone; God is at work in you. Ask Him to give you both the desire and the strength to do what pleases Him today.

v.t: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.

response.guide: Choose one verse to carry with you today and hide it in your heart. Ask God to use it to guard you from sin. Read it again before you go to bed.

v.t: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.

response.guide: Repentance means turning around and heading back to God. Is there a direction you need to turn from? Turn toward Him now, and let Him refresh your soul.

v.t: Repent, then, and turn back, so that your sins may be wiped away,

response.guide: You have been crucified with Christ, and He now lives in you. Ask Him to live His life through you today. Let your choices reflect the One who loves you and gave Himself for you.

v.t: I have been crucified with Christ, and I no longer live, but Christ lives in me. The life I live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself up for me.

response.guide: Submit yourself to God, and resist the enemy. Is there a temptation you keep facing? Name it, ask God for strength, and choose to stand firm today.

v.t: Submit yourselves, then, to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

listen.guide: Sit quietly for a minute and listen for your Shepherd’s voice. Notice what verse, thought, or person comes to mind, and write it down so you can remember it.

v.t: My sheep listen to My voice; I know them, and they follow Me.

listen.guide: Like young Samuel, tell the Lord that you are listening. Wait in the quiet, and write down whatever He brings to your heart.

v.t: Then the LORD came and stood there, calling as before, “Samuel! Samuel!” And Samuel answered, “Speak, for Your servant is listening.”

listen.guide: Be still and listen to what the Lord will say, for He speaks peace to His people. If a word of peace or direction comes, write it in a journal or on your phone.

v.t: I will listen to what God the LORD will say; for He will surely speak peace to His people and His saints; He will not let them return to folly.

listen.guide: Ask God if there is a way He wants you to walk today, and then listen. Write down any gentle nudge, verse, or name that comes to mind.

v.t: And whether you turn to the right or to the left, your ears will hear this command behind you: “This is the way. Walk in it.”

listen.guide: Ask God to show you His unfailing love this morning and the way you should go. Rest in the silence for a few moments, and write down anything He shows you.

v.t: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.

listen.guide: God spoke to Elijah not in the wind or the fire, but in a gentle whisper. Quiet your mind, listen for His whisper, and write down what you sense.

v.t: After the earthquake there was a fire, but the LORD was not in the fire. And after the fire came a still, small voice.

listen.guide: God invites you to call to Him, and He promises to answer. Ask Him a question that is on your heart, wait quietly, and write down what comes.

v.t: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.

listen.guide: If you need wisdom about something, ask God for it now and give Him time to answer. Write down any thought, verse, or next step that comes to mind.

v.t: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.

listen.guide: Let your soul rest quietly in God for a minute, waiting on Him alone. Then write down what He seems to be putting on your heart today.

v.t: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.

listen.guide: Ask the Holy Spirit to guide you into truth as you sit in silence. Write down any verse, insight, or person He brings to mind.

v.t: However, when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth. For He will not speak on His own, but He will speak what He hears, and He will declare to you what is to come.

listen.guide: When you hear God’s voice today, keep your heart soft and open. Listen for a moment, and write down anything He asks of you so you can follow through.

v.t: As it has been said: “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts, as you did in the rebellion.”

listen.guide: Ask God to open your eyes to see wonderful things in His Word. Think back over today’s verse, and write down one thing that stood out to you.

v.t: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.

listen.guide: Like Mary, sit at Jesus’ feet for a few quiet moments and simply listen. Write down whatever He speaks to your heart, even if it feels small.

v.t: She had a sister named Mary, who sat at the Lord’s feet listening to His message.

listen.guide: Faith grows by hearing the word of Christ. Read today’s verse again slowly, listen for the phrase that speaks to you, and write it down.

v.t: Consequently, faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.

listen.guide: God blesses those who listen to Him and wait at His door each day. Wait at His door in silence for a moment, and write down what you hear.

v.t: Blessed is the man who listens to me, watching daily at my doors, waiting at the posts of my doorway.

listen.guide: God wakes your ear morning by morning to listen like a student. Ask Him what He wants to teach you today, and jot down what comes to mind.

v.t: The Lord GOD has given Me the tongue of discipleship, to sustain the weary with a word. He awakens Me morning by morning; He awakens My ear to listen as a disciple.

listen.guide: Ask God to show you His ways and teach you His paths. Sit quietly, then write down any direction, verse, or person He places on your heart.

v.t: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths. Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

listen.guide: Jesus stands at the door and knocks, waiting to come in and spend time with you. Open the door of your heart in the quiet, and write down what He says.

v.t: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me.

listen.guide: On the mountain, the Father spoke of Jesus and said to listen to Him. Spend a quiet moment listening to Jesus, and write down what He brings to mind.

v.t: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!”

closing.text: Go into your day knowing you are loved and never alone. The Lord goes with you into every room and every conversation. Walk in His peace.
May the Lord bless you and keep you. May His face shine on you and give you peace today. Go gently, child of God.
You have met with God, and He goes with you now. Carry His word in your heart like bread for the journey. Share some of it with someone who needs it.
This time of prayer is ending, but your walk with God is not. Keep talking with Him through the day, in the car, at your desk, in the kitchen. He is always listening.
Go in peace. Whatever this day brings, God is already there, and His grace will be enough. Rest in that.
May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace as you trust in Him. May you overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit. Go and shine.
Take a deep breath and step into your day. You are forgiven, you are loved, and you are His. Let that shape everything you do.
Remember the two fish: one for you and one to give away. You have received your portion today. Now go and give some away with a kind word or today’s verse.
As you go, may the peace of Christ guard your heart and mind. When worry returns, turn back to Him with a simple prayer. He will be there.
The Lord is your Shepherd today too. He will lead you, provide for you, and stay close. Go in His care.
May you walk in the light today, as He is in the light. May your words be kind and your steps be steady. Go with God.
You do not have to carry this day alone. Jesus walks beside you and goes before you. Go in His strength, not your own.
Close this time with a grateful heart. God heard every word you prayed, and He is working even now. Go and watch for His hand today.
May the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you. Go in peace and serve the Lord with gladness.
Carry one verse with you today and return to it when the day gets loud. God’s word will steady you. Go in peace.
You have been with Jesus, and that changes you. Let His love show in how you speak and listen today. Go and be a blessing.
Whatever you face today, you face it with God. He is your refuge, your strength, and your help. Go in peace, and come back tomorrow to meet with Him again.
